newsitem.title: USA: Group may seek to acquire Aztar.
newsitem.headline: Group may seek to acquire Aztar.

text.p: A group led by Sterling Foster Holding Corp said on Monday that they own about six percent of Aztar Corp's outstanding shares, and may seek to acquire the firm in the future.

"We believe that the stock of Aztar Corp is substantially undervalued and that the true value of the company's operating property is significantly in excess of the stock's current price," Adam Lierberman, Sterling Foster president, said in a statement.
Sterling Foster, an investment banking firm, filed a Schedule 13D form with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission stating its ownership of approximately 6 percent of Aztar common stock.
A spokesman for Aztar, a gaming company that owns and operates casino's in Nevada, New Jersey and Missouri, declined to comment on Sterling Foster's actions.
Aztar, along with other gaming enterprises, has been indicated in the past year as a likely target for merger or takeover, according to analysts.
